title: Omnidirectional 3-Agent-Per-Phone With Revolving Omni Messaging
body:
Every phone node in the federation MUST run exactly 3 named agents:
  1. ACTIVATION agent (trixie) — D15 DEVICE — opens doors, enables ADB, scans hardware
  2. COMMS agent (debora) — D22 TRANSLATION — establishes all channels, tests reachability
  3. HEARTBEAT agent (micro-agent) — D44 HEARTBEAT — 30s pulse, CPU/RAM, bus alive

All 3 agents MUST be OMNIDIRECTIONAL:
  - Send AND receive on ALL available transports simultaneously
  - Revolving omni messaging: cycle through transports in priority order
  - Transport priority: ADB-reverse > LAN-direct > MQTT > MQTT-SN > Redis > HTTP-hybrid
  - If primary fails, auto-fallback to next; if ALL fail, queue locally and retry
  - Each agent maintains its own transport state and reports it in every heartbeat

Revolving Omni Messaging Protocol:
  - Redis pub/sub for real-time inter-agent state sharing
  - MQTT for reliable delivery to colony orchestrator
  - MQTT-SN for low-bandwidth/lossy connections (cellular, Bluetooth)
  - HTTP BEHCS bus for cube-gated verified delivery
  - Hybrid mode: fire on ALL available transports simultaneously, deduplicate at receiver

Each phone has its own backend:
  - Local BEHCS sidecar (behcs-spined-node.js or micro-agent-behcs.py)
  - Local cube store for offline operation
  - Auto-translator for Termux shell path differences (ip→ifconfig, dumpsys→termux-api)

Visual proof check: EVERY agent action MUST be verifiable via phone screenshot.
  - Use ADB screencap or mirror API to capture user screen
  - Screenshot BEFORE claiming success (per feedback_visual_verify)
  - User screen state is D11 PROOF for phone operations

White room: All agent messages pass through white room sanitization before bus relay.
Shannon part: Each agent message gets 6-part Shannon review before dispatch.
Cube alignment: D15+D22+D44 per phone, D0 runtime consumes all.
